description: Expected results for control test data (D3 detector validation)

positive.name: dn_copied_renamed
positive.description: Copy of TV code with identifier renaming and reformatting

positive_must_detect.reason: K-gram detector replaces identifiers with stubs, so should find copied structure despite renaming

negative_must_not_detect_above.reason: Independent queue code is structurally different from stream operations

positive_may_not_detect.reason: Line-by-line comparison is sensitive to reformatting (comments, line breaks)

B_line_by_line.note: This detector is weaker for renamed code; mainly catches verbatim copies

positive_must_detect.reason: Procedure structure and token sequence are similar; signatures differ (renaming)

negative_must_not_detect_above.reason: Different algorithms (stream init vs queue init)

validation_procedure.step1: Run all three detectors on test-data/
validation_procedure.step2: For each positive example: verify at least detector A or C reports similarity >= min_similarity
validation_procedure.step3: For each negative example: verify all detectors report similarity <= max_similarity
validation_procedure.step4: If validation fails, adjust detector parameters (k, threshold) and retest
validation_procedure.step5: After successful validation, detectors are ready for full audit run

notes: These test cases are synthetic but based on patterns common in Turbo Vision library
Real audit (D3) will use actual TV and DN source code
Control test results will guide threshold selection for production detectors
